definitions.gloss: full-time employment; full-time work; regular work
definitions.explanation: Working at a fixed schedule on a regular, full-time basis, as opposed to part-time or temporary work. Commonly used in job descriptions and employment contexts.

examples.japanese: {常勤|じょうきん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{常勤|じょうきん}{講師|こうし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: He works as a full-time lecturer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{非常勤|ひじょうきん}→非常勤：10675_hijoukin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{常勤|じょうきん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{切|き}り{替|か}えたい→切り替える：04239_kirikaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{空|あ}き→空き：10464_aki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I want to switch from part-time to full-time, but there are no openings.

notes:
USAGE:
{常勤|じょうきん} combines {常|じょう} (always, regular) and {勤|きん} (work, service). It is most commonly used as a modifier before job titles. The antonym is ⟦{非常勤|ひじょうきん}→非常勤：10675_hijoukin⟧ (part-time, non-regular).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {常勤|じょうきん}⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧ (full-time employee)
- {常勤|じょうきん}{講師|こうし} (full-time lecturer)
- {常勤|じょうきん}⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧ (full-time doctor)
- ⟦{非常勤|ひじょうきん}→非常勤：10675_hijoukin⟧ (part-time, non-regular)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦フルタイム→フルタイム：26894_furutaimu⟧ is the loanword equivalent used in casual contexts. ⟦{正社員|せいしゃいん}→正社員：13194_seishain⟧ refers to a regular employee with full benefits, which often overlaps with {常勤|じょうきん} but emphasizes employment status rather than working hours.
